raw_response:
structural program complete
There is no genuinely new, non-vacuous, label-free structural bridge direction still worth deriving inside the current Window6↔codon-Q6 frame.
The reason is not that every conceivable invariant has been tried. The reason is that the admissible search space has collapsed under the correct equivalence relation. You have already conditioned on the biologically obvious composition carriers, the codon-box and wobble geometry, degeneracy, edge margins, boundary degrees, component structure, square faces, quotient topology, bypass conductance, spanning-tree compression, and finally the lone surviving edge-hiding statistic  $e_{\rm in}$ . At that point, any “new” invariant is almost certainly one of three things:


A re-expression of  $e_{\rm in}$ .
It may be phrased as curvature, flow, spectral gap, path redundancy, higher-dimensional face incidence, local expansion, or resistance, but its signal will come from synonymous Hamming-1 edge hiding.


A re-expression of composition.
It will smuggle in GC-position, box structure, wobble class, degeneracy, branch splits, codon-pair geometry, or fiber size profile.


A finite-object fingerprint.
Because the code is finite, one can always invent a label-free-looking functional that separates it. But if the functional is not canonical before seeing the standard code, and if it has no principled null that does not already encode  $e_{\rm in}$  or composition, it is numerology.


The strongest “remaining structural direction” would be a closure theorem, not a new bridge: prove that a broad algebra of natural  $Q_6$ -partition invariants factors into composition-controlled terms plus  $e_{\rm in}$  plus null residual under the registered null family. That would be useful for rigor and presentation. But it is not a new scientific direction. It formalizes the endpoint.
Starting a new math-bio structural pairing, such as RNA secondary-structure arc diagrams, tRNA cloverleaf topology, ribosomal decoding geometry, matroids, associahedra, or error-correcting codes, would be a new program, not a continuation of this one. Without external biological data or an independently forced non-circular map, it would almost certainly fall back into count matching, grammar equivalence, or post-hoc analogy. That would weaken the current result.
The real achievement here is narrowness: the bridge did not find a cloud of suggestive coincidences. It found one certified structural contact.

$$\text{Window6 separating endpoint}
\quad\leftrightarrow\quad
\text{genetic-code tolerant endpoint}$$

The mediator is  $e_{\rm in}$ : synonymous Hamming-1 edge hiding. Everything else canonical in the label-free codon graph is typical once the right controls are imposed.
So the remaining frontier is empirical, not structural. The decisive unresolved issue is whether the structural positive has biological force.
The single most important open question is:
Is the standard code’s experimentally measured one-step mistranslation robustness fully mediated by  $e_{\rm in}$ , or does any residual robustness remain after conditioning on synonymous edge hiding?
